claims.description: format is idempotent and parse-stable: format(format(s)) === format(s), and parse(format(s)) deep-equals parse(s) ignoring line/col
run(src) returns { value, output }: value is the last form's value and output collects print lines in execution order; print itself returns nil

tasks.description: Create src/format.mjs with format(src) per DESIGN.md section 10 (60-char one-line rule, 2-space continuation indent, exactly one blank line between top-level forms, trailing newline, strings re-escaped, comments dropped). Tests in tests/format.test.mjs must pin idempotence and parse-stability on nested inputs that exercise BOTH layout branches.

Extend src/index.mjs per DESIGN.md section 9: add run(src) returning { value, output } (output joins the global env __out buffer) and re-export format from src/format.mjs. Tests in tests/run-api.test.mjs cover multi-print programs, print ordering, print returning nil, and run on a program whose value is a list.
